summary: Six named surgeons, 1,000+ procedures and a booking form are strong, but leftover form text, a demo site link and conflicting numbers undercut a high ticket brand.

findings.problem: Form labels leak onto the page (-None- Internet Walk in Phone and Please select Google Yahoo MSN Facebook), and the Consult Now and financing block repeats about 8 times.
findings.cost: Leftover text and repeats make a surgical clinic look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean form and each block shown once.

findings.problem: The price guide View More and Full price guide links go to aesthetica.cmsmasters.net, a theme demo site, and several slider images are dummy.png.
findings.cost: Patients who click for prices land on a demo site and lose trust.
findings.fix: Your own price page and real images.

findings.problem: The page says more than 250 five-star reviews and also a 4.8 rating from 1000+ reviews, transforming looks for the last 17 years and more than 15 years, and quotes prices in $ with simple flat rate beside ranges.
findings.cost: Conflicting numbers make patients doubt every claim.
findings.fix: One verified set of figures and prices in AED.

findings.problem: Reviews include Your laiyar and a blank one, Prof. Dr. Dr. Wolfgang Funk has a doubled Dr., WhatsApp (+971 4 348 5575) differs from the main phone, and no before and after images show.
findings.cost: Surgery patients choose on real results and clear contact.
findings.fix: Good reviews, a results gallery and one contact number.

redesign: A clean booking form, one phone and WhatsApp, and prices in AED.
Real reviews, a captioned results gallery and consistent facts.
